home.heroTitle: Summer camp centre by the sea
home.heroSubtitle: Book any dates for your organized group — accommodation, meals and recreation grounds in one place.
home.offerTitle: Everything you need for a perfect camp
home.offerSubtitle: Designed for comfort and utility, so your group has an unforgettable stay by the sea.

step1.title: Pick dates
step1.body: Choose your preferred dates and group size through the online portal.

step2.title: We confirm
step2.body: Our team reviews and confirms availability within 24 hours.

step3.title: Pay the deposit
step3.body: Secure your reservation with a deposit, and start packing!

rooms.title: Accommodation
rooms.body: 2-, 3- and 4-person rooms with private bathrooms — beds for several hundred participants in total.

meals.title: Meals
meals.body: Our own kitchen and canteen: four meals a day, menus adapted to participants' diets.

grounds.title: Recreation grounds
grounds.body: Sports fields, common rooms, a beach on the sea and a supervised swimming area.

home.contactLead: Have questions about hosting your group at CampCenter? Our team is ready to help you plan the perfect stay.
